sources.role: WinArcadia native config, DirectInput, state and machine implementation
official libretro build and input documentation

paths.naming: Line-oriented key=value INI. The source writes controller_left/controller_right (0..8), leftbutton_0..7 and rightbutton_0..7; it also stores host keyboard scancodes, paths and unrelated settings.

paths.path: The controller fields in Configs\WinArcadia.ini; DirectInput devices are enumerated at runtime as the first and second attached joystick.
paths.naming: controller_left/right values 0=none, 1=trackball, 2/3=first/second DirectInput joystick, 4=second analog joystick, 5..8=first/second DirectInput or analog pad. button fields are one-based joyfires[8] selectors; axes are fixed DirectInput X/Y. Device product names are runtime-only.
evidence: source:WinArcadia/ff.c DirectInput enumeration, X/Y polling and rgbButtons @8ca27c9

paths.path: No universal battery-save sidecar is established by the reviewed WinArcadia source.
paths.naming: Guest/software or machine-specific; do not infer a generic SRAM path.

paths.path: User-selected .COS files under the configured Games path; quicksave uses QUICKSAV.COS and exit autosave uses AUTOSAVE.COS.
paths.naming: WinArcadia COS state files carry a magic byte, COS version, state/recording kind and machine memory map; the normal Save State dialog chooses the filename.
evidence: source:WinArcadia/ibm.c quicksave path and engine1.c autosave path @8ca27c9
source:WinArcadia/formats.c engine_save COS header and serialization @8ca27c9

paths.path: Machine-specific built-in or selectable ROM images; no one universal BIOS filename/checksum is published for the multi-machine frontend.
paths.naming: Some machine BIOS variants are selected by WinArcadia settings (for example PIPBUG, BINBUG, CD2650, PHUNSY and Selbstbau).

paths.path: No cryptographic key file is documented.

paths.naming: RetroArch key = value syntax plus AmiArcadia core options; no native profile.

paths.path: RetroArch per-port input_playerN_* bindings; core exposes RETRO_DEVICE_JOYPAD descriptors.
paths.naming: Frontend RetroPad bindings; D-pad doubles as paddle, B/Y/A map keypad/fire.

paths.path: No save RAM is exposed (only SYSTEM_RAM); no battery saves persist.
paths.naming: retro_get_memory returns data only for SYSTEM_RAM; SAVE_RAM size is 0.
Fixed 36KB serialized snapshots via frontend slot files.
